51400.meaning1: it could be my; it would be for me

examples.text: yaṃ, bhikkhave, sadevakassa lokassa samārakassa sabrahmakassa sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā, tam'ahaṃ na jānāmī'ti vadeyyaṃ, taṃ mam'assa musā.
ovadatu maṃ, bhante, bhagavā, anusāsatu maṃ, bhante, bhagavā, yaṃ mam'assa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyā'ti.
yañ'hi taṃ, āvuso, sammā vadamāno vadeyya, satthārā anuggahito sāvako mah'ābhiññataṃ patto'ti, mamaṃ taṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya, satthārā anuggahito sāvako mah'ābhiññataṃ patto'ti.
yo hoti bhikkhu arahaṃ katāvī, khīṇ'āsavo antimadehadhārī, ahaṃ vadāmī'ti'pi so vadeyya, mamaṃ vadantī'ti'pi so vadeyyā'ti?
so iti paṭisañcikkhati, mamaṃ kho pubbe bahū ahesuṃ mitt'āmaccā ñātisālohitā. tassa me te anupubbena parikkhayaṃ gatā.
tassa rūpaṃ… vedanaṃ… saññaṃ… saṅkhāre… viññāṇaṃ samanvesato yāvatā viññāṇassa gati, yam'pi'ssa taṃ hoti ahan'ti vā maman'ti vā asmī'ti vā tam'pi tassa na hotī'ti.
kiṃ pan'imassa mattaṭṭhakassa kāyassa taṇh'upādinnassa ahan'ti vā maman'ti vā asmī'ti vā? atha khv'āssa no't'ev'ettha hoti.
kathaṃ jānato pan'āyasmato, kathaṃ passato imasmiñ'ca saviññāṇake kāye bahiddhā ca sabbanimittesu ahaṃkāramamaṃkāramān'ānusayā samūhatā'ti?

51405.meaning1: takes as mine; makes one's own; treasures; cherishes; possesses

examples.text: cakkhūhi n'eva lol'assa, gāmakathāya āvaraye sotaṃ, rase ca n'ānugijjheyya, na ca mamāyetha kiñci lokasmiṃ.

imaṃ ce tumhe, bhikkhave, diṭṭhiṃ evaṃ parisuddhaṃ evaṃ pariyodātaṃ allīyetha kelāyetha dhanāyetha mamāyetha, api nu me tumhe, bhikkhave, kull'ūpamaṃ dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājāneyyātha nittharaṇ'atthāya no gahaṇ'atthāyā'ti?

51408.grammar: fem, abstr, act, from mamāyati, deno

51410.commentary: (JAa) yass'imāni mamāyiṃsū'ti tāta nārada, ye mama upaṭṭhākā ca orodhā ca imasmiṃ uyyāne mahantena yasena mayā saddhiṃ vicarantā imāni ṭhānāni mamāyiṃsu piyāyiṃsu, kataraṃ nu te disataṃ gatā, kattha te pesitā.

examples.text: imā tā pokkharaṇī rammā, cakkavākapakūjitā, mandālakehi sañchannā, padum'uppalakehi ca, yass'imāni mamāyiṃsu, kiṃ nu te disataṃ gatā.

51411.meaning1: (something) taken as mine; made mine; possessed; treasured; cherished
51411.commentary: (DHPa) mamāyitan'ti yassa ahan'ti vā maman'ti vā gāho n'atthi. (SNPa) mamāyitānī'ti taṇhādiṭṭhimamāyitāni.

examples.text: sabbaso nāmarūpasmiṃ, yassa n'atthi mamāyitaṃ, asatā ca na socati, sa ve bhikkhū'ti vuccati.
evaṃvihārī sato appamatto, bhikkhu caraṃ hitvā mamāyitāni, jātiṃ jaraṃ sokapariddavañ'ca, idh'eva vidvā pajaheyya dukkhaṃ.

51412.meaning1: taken as mine; possessed; treasured; cherished

examples.text: dīgharattañ'h'etaṃ, bhikkhave, assutavato puthujjanassa ajjhositaṃ mamāyitaṃ parāmaṭṭhaṃ
adinnaṃ nāmaṃ yaṃ adinnaṃ anissaṭṭhaṃ apariccattaṃ rakkhitaṃ gopitaṃ mamāyitaṃ parapariggahitaṃ. etaṃ adinnaṃ nāma.

51414.meaning1: meant for me; intended for me
51414.meaning2: meant for me; intended for me
51414.commentary: (SNa) mam'uddesiko'ti ahaṃ uddisitabb'aṭṭhena uddeso assā'ti mam'uddesiko, mam'eva uddissitvā maṃ paccāsīsamāno bhikkhusaṅgho hotu mama accayena mā vā ahosi, yaṃ vā taṃ vā hotū'ti iti vā pana yassa assā'ti attho.

examples.text: yassa nūna, ānanda, evam'assa, ahaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ pariharissāmī'ti vā, mam'uddesiko bhikkhusaṅgho'ti vā, so nūna, ānanda, bhikkhusaṅghaṃ ārabbha kiñci'd'eva udāhareyya.

51415.meaning1: of me alone; only mine; mine alone

examples.text: mam'eva etaṃ na hi tvaṃ paresaṃ, sannāhakāle paridevitena kiṃ, sabbaṃ idaṃ calam'iti pekkhamāno, abhinikkhamiṃ amatapadaṃ jigīsaṃ.
mam'eva kata maññantu, gihīpabbajitā ubho, mam'ev'ātivasā assu, kicc'ākiccesu kismici. iti bālassa saṅkappo, icchā māno ca vaḍḍhati.

51416.meaning1: especially for me; for me alone; on my account

examples.text: abhijānāmi kho pan'āhaṃ, aggivessana, anekasatāya parisāya dhammaṃ desetā. apissu maṃ ekam'eko evaṃ maññati, mam'ev'ārabbha samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ desetī'ti.

sace me tvaṃ, vappa, anuññeyyañ'c'eva anujāneyyāsi, paṭikkositabbañ'ca paṭikkoseyyāsi, yassa ca me bhāsitassa atthaṃ na jāneyyāsi mam'ev'ettha uttari paṭipuccheyyāsi, idaṃ, bhante, kathaṃ, imassa ko attho'ti, siyā no ettha kathāsallāpo'ti.

51418.meaning1: vital spot; nerve centre; vulnerable point
51418.meaning2: vital spot of the body, nerve centre

examples.text: kāmaṃ yahiṃ icchasi tena gaccha, viddho'si mammamhi vikaṇṇakena, hato'si bhattena suvāditena, lolo ca macche anubandhamāno.
n'ābhisajjī'ti kuṭilakaṇṭako viya tattha tattha mammaṃ tudanto viya na laggi.

51419.meaning2: wounding a vital spot, very harsh or fatal

51420.meaning2: vital spot of the body, nerve centre

51422.meaning1: made of; constructed by; built of

examples.text: manopubbaṅ'gamā dhammā, manoseṭṭhā manomayā, manasā ce paduṭṭhena, bhāsati vā karoti vā, tato naṃ dukkham'anveti, cakkaṃva vahato padaṃ.
na vedagū diṭṭhiyā na mutiyā, sa mānam'eti na hi tam'mayo so, na kammunā no'pi sutena neyyo, anūpanīto sa nivesanesu.
mayañ'hi, bho gotama, antevāsiṃ labhitvā paṭhamaṃ evaṃ gaṇāpema, ekaṃ ekakaṃ, dve dukā, tīṇi tikā, cattāri catukkā, pañca pañcakā, cha chakkā, satta sattakā, aṭṭha aṭṭhakā
mayañ'hi, bhante, pubbe aññatitthiye paribbājake anājānīy'eva samāne ājānīyā'ti amaññimha, anājānīy'eva samāne ājānīyabhojanaṃ bhojimha, anājānīy'eva samāne ājānīyaṭhāne ṭhapimha.
pare micchāvimuttī bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammāvimuttī bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.
suppaṭipann'āttha, mārisā, ujuppaṭipann'āttha, mārisā, ek'antasukhassa lokassa sacchikiriyāya. mayam'pi hi, mārisā, evaṃpaṭipannā ek'antasukhaṃ lokaṃ upapannā'ti? iti puṭṭhā no'ti vadanti.
mayam'pi kho, āvuso, sāvakānaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ desema, etha tumhe, āvuso, pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe satta bojjh'aṅge yathābhūtaṃ bhāvethā'ti.
sace, bhante, āyasmato ānandassa gāmavaraṃ kappeyya, gāmavaram'pi mayaṃ āyasmato ānandassa dadeyyāma. api ca, bhante, mayam'p'etaṃ jānāma, n'etaṃ āyasmato ānandassa kappatī'ti.
nissaṃsayena tvaṃ buddho bhavissasi, mayam'p'etaṃ jānāma, yass'etāni nimittāni paññāyanti, ek'antena so buddho hoti
pare ca na vijānanti, mayam'ettha yamāmase, ye ca tattha vijānanti, tato sammanti medhagā.
yesañ'ca mayaṃ cīvara-piṇḍapāta-sen'āsana-gilānappaccaya-bhesajjaparikkhāraṃ paribhuñjāma, tesaṃ te kārā amhesu mahapphalā bhavissanti mah'ānisaṃsā
n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, lokena vivadāmi, loko'va mayā vivadati. na, bhikkhave, dhammavādī kenaci lokasmiṃ vivadati.
attadaṇḍā bhayaṃ jātaṃ, janaṃ passatha medhagaṃ, saṃvegaṃ kittayissāmi, yathā saṃvijitaṃ mayā.
ko nu kho, bho, aññatra mayā mahesakkhataro vā mahālābhataro vā!

51431.meaning1: by me too; with me too

examples.text: mayā'pi kho etaṃ, māgaṇḍiya, n'eva diṭṭhaṃ na sutaṃ rājā vā rājamah'āmatto vā pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappito samaṅgībhūto paricārayamāno kāmataṇhaṃ appahāya kāmapariḷāhaṃ appaṭivinodetvā vigatapipāso ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto vihāsi vā viharati vā viharissati vā.

puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti. so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno evam'āha, kiṃ nu kho tumhe āyasmanto atibāḷhaṃ mayi byāvaṭā yāva idān'āhaṃ sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāy'āvattissāmī'ti.
yehi manussā āgataṃ bhikkhuṃ na manasi karonti, tatra bhikkhussa evaṃ hoti, kosu nāma idāni maṃ imasmiṃ kule paribhindi, virattarūpā dān'ime mayi manussā'ti

51433.grammar: pron, 1st loc sg of ahaṃ, loc abs
51433.meaning1: when I; as I; while I

examples.text: ayañ'hi so udapāno mayi upasaṅkamante sabbaṃ taṃ tiṇañ'ca bhusañ'ca mukhato ovamitvā acchassa udakassa anāvilassa vippasannassa yāva mukhato pūrito vissandanto maññe ṭhito'ti!
kadā mayūrassa sikhaṇḍino vane, dijassa sutvā girigabbhare rutaṃ, paccuṭṭhahitvā amatassa pattiyā, saṃcintaye taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.
mayūrakoñc'ābhirutamhi kānane, dīpīhi byagghehi purakkhato vasaṃ, kāye apekkhaṃ jaha mā virādhaya, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.

51436.commentary: (DNa) mayūrakoñc'ābhirudā'ti mayūrehi koñcasakuṇehi ca abhirudā upagītā. (JAa) mayūrakoñc'ābhirudan'ti ubhosu tīresu vanaghaṭāyaṃ vasantehi mayūrehi ca koñcehi ca abhirudaṃ upakūjitaṃ.

examples.text: mayūrakoñc'ābhirude, kokila-abhinikūjite, khattiyānaṃ kule bhadde, kiṃ nu sukhataraṃ tato.

51437.grammar: pron, 1st dat sg of ahaṃ, abbrev of mayhaṃ

examples.text: sattisūl'ūpamā kāmā, khandh'āsaṃ adhikuṭṭanā, yaṃ tvaṃ kāmaratiṃ brūsi, arati mayha sā ahū'ti.

51438.grammar: pron, 1st gen sg of ahaṃ, abbrev of mayhaṃ

examples.text: kulamhi mitte ca piye ca ñātake, khiḍḍāratiṃ kāmaguṇañ'ca loke, sabbaṃ pahāya imam'ajjhupāgato, atho'pi tvaṃ citta na mayha tussasi.
tathā tu kassāmi yathā'pi issaro, yaṃ labbhati tena'pi hotu me alaṃ, vīriyena taṃ mayha vas'ānayissaṃ, gajaṃ'va mattaṃ kusal'aṅkusaggaho.

evaṃ vutte tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, bhagavantaṃ'y'eva ārabbha sati udapādi, aho nūna bhagavā, aho nūna sugato, yo imesaṃ dhammānaṃ sukusalo'ti. bhagavā, bhante, kusalo, bhagavā pakataññū abhisaññānirodhassa.
tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave etadahosi, kimhi nu kho sati jarāmaraṇaṃ hoti kiṃpaccayā jarāmaraṇan'ti
atha kho, bhikkhave, kāḷiyā dāsiyā etadahosi, mayhaṃ kho ayyāya evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato, soratā vedehikā gahapatānī, nivātā vedehikā gahapatānī, upasantā vedehikā gahapatānī'ti.
uttam'aṅgaruhā mayhaṃ, ime jātā vayoharā, pātubhūtā devadūtā, pabbajjāsamayo mamā'ti.
tassa mayhaṃ, aggivessana, etadahosi, na kho āḷārasseva kālāmassa atthi saddhā, mayhaṃ'p'atthi saddhā, na kho āḷārasseva kālāmassa atthi vīriyaṃ, mayhaṃ'p'atthi vīriyaṃ
sa kho so bhikkhave ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati, na kho mayh'ev'ekassa sabbehi piyehi manāpehi nānābhāvo vinābhāvo
505, 482. jara marānaṃ jīra jiyya miyyā vā.
jara mara'icc'etesaṃ dhātūnaṃ jīra jiyya miyy'ādesā honti vā. jīrati, jīranti, jiyyati, jiyyanti, miyyati, miyyanti, marati, maranti.
evañ'hi, bhikkhave, tassa purisassa hoti, imaṃ c'āhaṃ aṅgārakāsuṃ papatissāmi, tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigacchāmi maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhan'ti
maraṇena'pi taṃ pahīyati, yaṃ puriso mam'idan'ti maññati, etam'pi viditvā paṇḍito, na mamattāya nametha māmako.
rājūhi nāma corā niggaṇhitabbā, no acorā. idha pana corānaṃ kiñci bhayaṃ n'atthi, acorā maraṇaṃ labhanti. aho imasmiṃ loke ayuttaṃ vattati, aho adhammo vattatī'ti.

51447.meaning1: weapon; means of killing; instrument of death

examples.text: katame satta phalā satt'ānisaṃsā? diṭṭh'eva dhamme paṭikacca aññaṃ ārādheti. no ce diṭṭh'eva dhamme paṭikacca aññaṃ ārādheti, atha maraṇakāle aññaṃ ārādheti.
manussaviggaho nāma yaṃ mātukucchismiṃ paṭhamaṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ paṭhamaṃ viññāṇaṃ pātubhūtaṃ, yāva maraṇakālā etth'antare eso manussaviggaho nāma.

51449.commentary: (VINa) tathā hi'ssa tam'ev'ātthaṃ dassento, maraṇasaññī'tiādim'āha. yasmā c'ettha saṅkappo'ti na'y'idaṃ vitakkassa nāmaṃ. atha kho saṃvidahanamattass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.

examples.text: cittasaṅkappo'ti maraṇasaññī maraṇacetano maraṇ'ādhippāyo.

51451.meaning1: subject to death; liable to die; having death intrinsic to one's nature; mortal

examples.text: maraṇadhammo'mhi, maraṇaṃ anatīto'ti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā.
maraṇadhammaṃ mā mīyī'ti n'atthi koci pāṭibhogo, samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā devo vā māro vā brahmā vā koci vā lokasmiṃ

51452.meaning1: subject to death; liable to die; mortal

examples.text: byādhidhammo jarādhammo, atho maraṇadhammiko, yathā dhammo tathāsantā, jigucchanti puthujjanā.

51453.meaning1: subject to death; liable to die; mortal

examples.text: byādhidhammā jarādhammā, atho maraṇadhammino, yathādhammā tathāsantā, jigucchanti puthujjanā.

51454.meaning1: I am liable to die; I am subject to death; death is part of my intrinsic nature

examples.text: maraṇadhammo'mhi, maraṇaṃ anatīto'ti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā.

51455.meaning1: ending in death; culminating in death
51455.commentary: (DHPa) maraṇ'antañ'hi jīvitaṃ yasmā sabbasattānaṃ jīvitaṃ maraṇapariyosānam'evā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: parijiṇṇam'idaṃ rūpaṃ, roganīḷaṃ pabhaṅguraṃ, bhijjati pūtisandeho, maraṇ'antañ'hi jīvitaṃ.

51456.meaning1: darkness of death; blindness of dying

examples.text: te jātisaṃvattanikesu saṅkhāresu abhiramanti … abhiratā … abhisaṅkharonti … abhisaṅkharitvā jāt'andhakāram'pi papatanti, jar'andhakāram'pi papatanti maraṇ'andhakāram'pi papatanti, soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyās'andhakāram'pi papatanti.

51457.meaning1: cliff of death; precipice of death

examples.text: te jātisaṃvattanike'pi saṅkhāre abhisaṅkharitvā jarāsaṃvattanike'pi saṅkhāre abhisaṅkharitvā maraṇasaṃvattanike'pi saṅkhāre abhisaṅkharitvā… maraṇapapātam'pi papatanti

51458.meaning1: ending in death; culminating in dying
51458.meaning2: having death as its end; culminating in the death

examples.text: addhuvaṃ me jīvitaṃ, dhuvaṃ me maraṇaṃ, avassaṃ mayā maritabbaṃ, maraṇapariyosānaṃ me jīvitaṃ, jīvitaṃ me aniyataṃ, maraṇaṃ me niyataṃ

51459.meaning1: flame of death; scorching heat of dying

examples.text: te jātisaṃvattanikesu saṅkhāresu abhiramanti … abhiratā … abhisaṅkharonti … abhisaṅkharitvā jātipariḷāhena'pi pariḍayhanti, jarāpariḷāhena'pi pariḍayhanti, maraṇapariḷāhena'pi pariḍayhanti, soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsa-pariḷāhena'pi pariḍayhanti.
katamāni pañca? ājīvikabhayaṃ, asilokabhayaṃ, parisasārajjabhayaṃ, maraṇabhayaṃ, duggatibhayaṃ. sa kho so, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati, n'āhaṃ ājīvikabhayassa bhāyāmi.
mige anto paviṭṭhe dvāraṃ pidahiṃsu. migo manusse disvā kampamāno maraṇabhayatajjito antonivesanaṅgaṇe ādhāvati paridhāvati.

51461.meaning1: peril of death; danger of dying
51461.commentary: (ANa) jarābhayan'ti jaraṃ paṭicca uppajjanakabhayaṃ. itaresu'pi es'eva nayo. vuttam'pi c'etaṃ, jaraṃ paṭicca uppajjati bhayaṃ bhayānakaṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃso cetaso utrāso. byādhiṃ paṭicca, maraṇaṃ paṭicca uppajjati bhayaṃ bhayānakaṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃso cetaso utrāso'ti (vibha. 921).

examples.text: katamāni tīṇi? jarābhayaṃ, byādhibhayaṃ, maraṇabhayan'ti. na, bhikkhave, mātā puttaṃ jīramānaṃ evaṃ labhati, ahaṃ jīrāmi, mā me putto jīrī'ti, putto vā pana mātaraṃ jīramānaṃ na evaṃ labhati, ahaṃ jīrāmi, mā me mātā jīrī'ti.
mige anto paviṭṭhe dvāraṃ pidahiṃsu. migo manusse disvā kampamāno maraṇabhayatajjito antonivesanaṅgaṇe ādhāvati paridhāvati.
mataṃ me jīvitā seyyaṃ, tasmā araññaṃ pavisitvā ubbandhitvā marissāmī'ti araññaṃ gato maraṇabhayatajjito paṭinivatti.

51464.meaning1: deadly; close to death; near to death

examples.text: evañ'hi, bhikkhave, tassa purisassa hoti, imaṃ c'āhaṃ aṅgārakāsuṃ papatissāmi, tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigacchāmi maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhan'ti
so rāg'ānuddhaṃsitena cittena maraṇaṃ vā nigaccheyya maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.

51466.meaning1: recognition of death; perception of dying; concept of death
51466.commentary: (SNa) maraṇasaññā'ti avassaṃ maritabbaṃ, maraṇapaṭibaddhaṃ me jīvitan'ti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhantassa uppannasaññā. (ANa) maraṇasaññā'ti maraṇaṃ ārabbha uppannasaññā.

examples.text: pañc'imā, bhikkhave, saññā bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā honti mah'ānisaṃsā amat'ogadhā amatapariyosānā. katamā pañca? asubhasaññā, maraṇasaññā, ādīnavasaññā, āhāre paṭikūlasaññā, sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā.
maraṇasaññā, bhikkhave, bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mah'ānisaṃsā amat'ogadhā amatapariyosānā'ti, iti kho pan'etaṃ vuttaṃ kiñ'c'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ?

51467.meaning1: fortified by the perception of death

examples.text: maraṇasaññāparicitena, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno cetasā bahulaṃ viharato jīvitanikantiyā cittaṃ patilīyati patikuṭati pativattati, na sampasāriyati upekkhā vā pāṭikulyatā vā saṇṭhāti.

51468.meaning1: percipient of killing; conscious of killing
51468.commentary: (VINa) tathā hi'ssa tam'ev'ātthaṃ dassento, maraṇasaññī'ti-ādim'āha. yasmā c'ettha saṅkappo'ti na'y'idaṃ vitakkassa nāmaṃ. atha kho saṃvidahanamattass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.

examples.text: cittasaṅkappo'ti maraṇasaññī maraṇacetano maraṇ'ādhippāyo.

51469.meaning1: recollection of death; mindfulness of dying

51470.commentary: (PYt) maraṇasamaye'ti maraṇ'āsannakāle, maraṇasamayasamīpe vā, samīp'atthe c'etaṃ bhummavacanaṃ.

examples.text: akatakalyāṇo hi kālaṃ katvā niraye nibbattati. mahādattasenāpati nāma kir'eko brāhmaṇabhatto ahosi, tassa maraṇasamaye nirayo upaṭṭhāsi. so brāhmaṇehi kiṃ passasī'ti vutto?

te jātisaṃvattanikesu saṅkhāresu abhiramanti, jarāsaṃvattanikesu saṅkhāresu abhiramanti, maraṇasaṃvattanikesu saṅkhāresu abhiramanti, soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsa-saṃvattanikesu saṅkhāresu abhiramanti.

51473.meaning1: recollection of death; mindfulness of dying
51473.commentary: (ANa) maraṇaṃ ārabbha uppannā sati maraṇassati, jīvit'indriy'upacched'ārammaṇāya satiyā etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.

examples.text: bhagavā etadavoca, maraṇassati, bhikkhave, bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mah'ānisaṃsā amat'ogadhā amatapariyosānā. bhāvetha no tumhe, bhikkhave, maraṇassatin'ti?

51474.meaning1: praise of death; advantage of death; (of) beauty of death
51474.commentary: (VIN) maraṇavaṇṇaṃ vā saṃvaṇṇeyyā'ti jīvite ādīnavaṃ dasseti, maraṇe vaṇṇaṃ bhaṇati.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu sañcicca manussaviggahaṃ jīvitā voropeyya, satthahārakaṃ v'āssa pariyeseyya, maraṇavaṇṇaṃ vā saṃvaṇṇeyya, maraṇāya vā samādapeyya

51475.meaning1: beating to death; punishing to death; (comm) ordering the killing
51475.commentary: (DNa) maraṇavadhenā'ti etaṃ māretha etaṃ ghātethā'ti evaṃ āṇattena maraṇavadhena.

examples.text: na pāṇidaṇḍehi pan'ātha leḍḍunā, satthena vā maraṇavadhena vā pana, ubbādhanāya paritajjanāya vā, na heṭhayī janatam'aheṭhako ahu.

51476.commentary: (DNa) maraṇavadhabhay'attano'ti ettha maraṇasaṅkhāto vadho maraṇavadho, maraṇavadhato bhayaṃ maraṇavadhabhayaṃ, taṃ attano jānitvā.

examples.text: maraṇavadhabhay'attano viditvā, paṭivirato paraṃ māraṇāy'ahosi, tena sucaritena saggam'agamā, sukataphalavipākam'anubhosi.

51478.meaning1: intending to kill; aiming to kill
51478.commentary: (VINa) tathā hi'ssa tam'ev'ātthaṃ dassento, maraṇasaññī'tiādim'āha. yasmā c'ettha saṅkappo'ti na'y'idaṃ vitakkassa nāmaṃ. atha kho saṃvidahanamattass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.

examples.text: cittasaṅkappo'ti maraṇasaññī maraṇacetano maraṇ'ādhippāyo.

51479.meaning1: who has conquered death; who has defeated death; who has mastered of death

examples.text: sāvako te mahāvīra, maraṇaṃ maraṇ'ābhibhū, ākaṅkhati cetayati, taṃ nisedha jutin'dhara.
añña'd'atthu, ayaṃ varāko idāni marissati, yaṃ yadeva hi ayaṃ padaṃ nikkhipati, tena tena santike maraṇassa hotī'ti taṃ jano karuṇāyati.
deva, idāni ṭhapetvā saccakiriyaṃ añño mama sakkhi n'atthi, sac'āyaṃ dārako tumhe paṭicca jāto, ākāse tiṭṭhatu, no ce, bhūmiyaṃ patitvā maratū'ti bodhisattassa pāde gahetvā ākāse khipi.

so kira vesālinagaradvāre ekaṃ kakudharukkhaṃ āruyha dvīhi pādehi rukkhasākhaṃ gaṇhitvā adhosiro olambanto kapilānaṃ me sataṃ detha, kahāpaṇe detha, paricārikaṃ detha, no ce dassatha, ito patitvā maranto nagaraṃ anagaraṃ karissāmī'ti vadati.

[ettha labheyy'āhaṃ… upasampadaṃ'ti vākyadvayaṃ sabbesu'pi mūlapotthakesu dissati, pārājikapāḷiyaṃ pana sudinnabhāṇavāre etaṃ n'atthi. pabbājetu maṃ bhagavā'ti idaṃ pana vākyaṃ marammapotthake y'eva dissati, pārājikapāḷiyañ'ca tadeva atthi]
[pabbājetu maṃ bhagavā'ti idaṃ pana vākyaṃ marammapotthake y'eva dissati, pārājikapāḷiyañ'ca tadeva atthi]
na yaṃ labbhā manussena, amanussena vā pana, jāto me mā mari putto, kuto labbhā alabbhiyaṃ.
brāhmaṇassa asiṃ ākaḍḍhitvā upasiṅghantassa maricacuṇṇāni nāsaṃ pavisitvā khipitu'kāmataṃ uppādesuṃ. tassa khipantassa nāsikā asidhārāya paṭihatā dvidhā chijji.
brāhmaṇassa asiṃ ākaḍḍhitvā upasiṅghantassa maricacuṇṇāni nāsaṃ pavisitvā khipitu'kāmataṃ uppādesuṃ. tassa khipantassa nāsikā asidhārāya paṭihatā dvidhā chijji.

51488.meaning1: should be dead; can die; will inevitably die

examples.text: addhuvaṃ me jīvitaṃ, dhuvaṃ me maraṇaṃ, avassaṃ mayā maritabbam'eva, maraṇapariyosānaṃ me jīvitaṃ, jīvitam'eva aniyataṃ, maraṇaṃ niyatan'ti evaṃ maraṇassatiṃ bhāvetha.
vissajjito gato so, aham'pi ekākinī vicintemi, āpucchitūna gacchaṃ, marituṃ vā pabbajissaṃ vā.

51491.meaning1: keeping within the boundary; staying within limit; maintaining norms

examples.text: kathañ'ca, doṇa, brāhmaṇo mariyādo hoti? idha, doṇa, brāhmaṇo ubhato sujāto hoti, mātito ca pitito ca, saṃsuddhagahaṇiko, yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena.
puna caparaṃ, mahārāja, khettaṃ mariyādāsampannaṃ hoti, tāya ca mariyādāya udakaṃ rakkhitvā dhaññaṃ paripāceti, evam'eva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yog'āvacarena sīlahirimariyādāsampannena bhavitabbaṃ
pheṇ'ūpamaṃ kāyam'imaṃ viditvā, marīcidhammaṃ abhisambudhāno, chetvāna mārassa papupphakāni, adassanaṃ maccurājassa gacche.
yathā pubbuḷakaṃ passe, yathā passe marīcikaṃ, evaṃ lokaṃ avekkhantaṃ, maccurājā na passati.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, gimhānaṃ pacchime māse ṭhite majjh'anhike kāle marīcikā phandati.
pheṇapiṇḍ'ūpamaṃ rūpaṃ, vedanā bubbuḷ'ūpamā, marīcik'ūpamā saññā, saṅkhārā kadal'ūpamā, māy'ūpamañ'ca viññāṇaṃ, desit'ādiccabandhunā.
